# General Updates — 8-13-1

**Goal:** A batch of small UI/UX polish changes across the home page, the app header,
the `/app` dashboard, and the two assessment pages (`/app/intake` and
`/app/audio-text-assessment`). No database or schema changes are required.

**Scope:** All changes are front-end only (React/Next.js + Tailwind). No migrations,
no new dependencies, no API changes.

---

## 1. Home page — hero CTA text

**File:** `nextjs/src/components/AuthAwareButtons.tsx`

The hero "Start Building Free" button lives in the default `variant` branch of
`AuthAwareButtons` (the unauthenticated branch):

```tsx
<Link href="/auth/register" className="...">
  Start Building Free
  <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-5 w-5" />
</Link>
```

**Change:** Replace the label `Start Building Free` → `Get Started Free`.

> Note: there is a *separate* "Get Started" label in the `nav` variant of the same
> component. Leave that one as-is unless the user asks; only the hero button changes.

---

## 2. Home page — purple → blue

**File:** `nextjs/src/app/page.tsx`

The home page uses Tailwind `violet-*` classes in several places. Replace them with
matching `blue-*` shades so the page reads as blue instead of purple:

| Location | Current | New |
|---|---|---|
| Hero badge pill | `bg-violet-100 text-violet-700` | `bg-blue-100 text-blue-700` |
| Hero image glow | `to-violet-200/40` | `to-blue-200/40` |
| "AI assistance" badge | `bg-violet-100 text-violet-700` | `bg-blue-100 text-blue-700` |
| Feature card "AI-Powered Writing" | `text-violet-600` / `bg-violet-50` | `text-blue-600` / `bg-blue-50` |

Search for all `violet` occurrences in `page.tsx` and swap them to `blue`. The primary
brand color (`primary-*`) is already a blue (`theme-sass3` ocean blues), so this makes
the page consistent.

**File:** `nextjs/src/app/page.tsx` (nav) and `nextjs/src/components/AuthAwareButtons.tsx` (`nav` variant)

The header has a plain-text Login link:

## 6. `/app` dashboard — page blocks + rename "Example Page"

**File:** `nextjs/src/app/app/page.tsx`

The "Quick Actions" card currently has two links: **User Settings** and **Example Page**
(which links to `/app/table`).

**Changes:**
1. Rename the "Example Page" block → **To Do List** (keep the `/app/table` link).
2. Add blocks for the other primary pages so the dashboard surfaces the main routes.
   Mirror the existing block markup (icon in a `bg-primary-50` circle + title + subtitle).
   Suggested blocks (matching the `AppLayout` navigation):

   - **Home** → `/app`
   - **Intake Assessment** → `/app/intake`
   - **Audio-Text Assessment** → `/app/audio-text-assessment`
   - **Resume Builder** → `/app/resume-builder`
   - **Resume Settings** → `/app/resume-builder/admin/settings`
   - **My Files** → `/app/storage`
   - **To Do List** → `/app/table`
   - **User Settings** → `/app/user-settings`

   Use appropriate `lucide-react` icons (e.g. `Home`, `Mic`, `FileText`, `Settings`,
   `Files`, `LucideListTodo`, `User`). Keep the existing `grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2`
   layout (or widen to `md:grid-cols-3` if the block count makes it feel crowded).

## 7. `/app/intake` — progress bar min-width 75%

**File:** `nextjs/src/components/IntakeForm.tsx`

The progress bar fill currently uses only a percentage width:

```tsx
<div className="mt-2 h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
  <div
    className="h-full bg-primary-600 transition-all duration-300"
    style={{ width: `${(recordedCount / totalQuestions) * 100}%` }}
  />
</div>
```

**Change:** Add a `minWidth: '75%'` to the fill's inline style so the bar never renders
below 75% width:

```tsx
style={{ width: `${(recordedCount / totalQuestions) * 100}%`, minWidth: '75%' }}
```

> This is the reference "look" for the shared progress bar (see item 9).

---

## 8. `/app/audio-text-assessment` — textareas by default + layout

**File:** `nextjs/src/components/QuestionBlock.tsx`

Currently the transcript `<textarea>` only renders when
`(showRecorder || isRecorded || isUploading || transcript) && onTranscriptChange`.

**Changes:**
1. **Show the textarea by default** whenever `onTranscriptChange` is provided (i.e. on
   the audio-text-assessment page). Remove the `showRecorder || isRecorded || isUploading
   || transcript` gate so the "My Answer" textarea is always visible.
2. **Layout:** on desktop, place the action buttons to the **left** of the textarea; on
   mobile, stack them (buttons above the textarea). Wrap the recording controls and the
   textarea in a flex container:
   ```tsx
   <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4">
     {/* left column: + Record Answer / AudioRecorder / uploading indicator */}
     <div className="md:w-1/5 flex flex-col gap-2">...</div>
     {/* right column: textarea */}
     <div className="md:flex-1">...</div>
   </div>
   ```
3. **Text field min-width 80%:** give the textarea container a `min-w-[80%]` (or set the
   textarea itself to `min-w-[80%]`) so the text field occupies at least 80% of the row.

> Keep the existing behavior on the `/app/intake` page (which also uses `QuestionBlock`)
> intact — the textarea should still only appear there after recording, since the intake
> page does not pass `onTranscriptChange`. Verify the gate logic still hides it there.

---

## 9. Shared progress bar component

**Goal:** Extract the intake page's progress bar into a reusable component and use it on
both `/app/intake` and `/app/audio-text-assessment`.

**New file:** `nextjs/src/components/ui/ProgressBar.tsx`

```tsx
interface ProgressBarProps {
  value: number        // 0–100
  minWidth?: number    // optional minimum width %, default 0
  className?: string
}
```

Render the intake-style markup:

```tsx
<div className={`mt-2 h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden ${className ?? ''}`}>
  <div
    className="h-full bg-primary-600 transition-all duration-300"
    style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value))}%`, minWidth: `${minWidth ?? 0}%` }}
  />
</div>
```

**Usage:**
- `IntakeForm.tsx`: replace the inline progress bar markup with `<ProgressBar
  value={(recordedCount / totalQuestions) * 100} minWidth={75} />` (preserves item 7).
- `AudioTextAssessmentForm.tsx`: the header card currently only shows text
  ("Progress: X of Y" + "% Complete"). Add the shared `<ProgressBar
  value={(recordedCount / totalQuestions) * 100} />` beneath that text so both pages
  share the same visual.
